summary: Keep thread browsing available when browser-local send storage cannot open

replay.detail: No saved action is submitted or retried by this change.

schema.detail: No browser or server schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Successful thread read and inbox grants remain available when protected outbox startup fails. Only thread Start and reply sends are withheld; the reply composer displays the saved-message storage failure separately from thread read failures.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Blocked database upgrades and disabled storage no longer prevent thread list, detail or timeline reads. Protected sends remain refused without an unprotected fallback, and drafts are preserved.
